entities.name: Dengue
entities.description: Acute mosquito-borne flaviviral infection caused by DENV-1 through 4, characterized by sudden high fever, retro-orbital pain, severe musculoskeletal aches, and potential progression during defervescence to systemic capillary leakage, thrombocytopenia, and hypovolemic shock.

entities.name: Abrupt High Fever
entities.description: Sudden onset of high temperature (39-40°C) marking the first phase of dengue illness.

entities.name: Biphasic Saddleback Fever
entities.description: Biphasic fever curve with temporary defervescence followed by secondary pyrexia spike.

entities.name: Severe Frontal Cephalalgia
entities.description: Intense debilitating frontal and retro-orbital headache accompanying acute viremia.

entities.name: Breakbone Myalgia
entities.description: Violent generalized muscle aches and lumbar discomfort characteristic of dengue fever.

entities.name: Severe Debilitating Arthralgia
entities.description: Severe generalized non-deforming joint aches accompanying acute dengue viremia.

entities.name: Generalized Lumbar Backpain
entities.description: Incapacitating axial lumbar pain commonly reported during the acute febrile period.

entities.name: Transient Facial Flushing
entities.description: Erythematous facial and neck flushing observed during the first 1-2 days of illness.

entities.name: Diffuse Erythematous Blanching
entities.description: Early diffuse blanching macular cutaneous erythema resolving prior to critical phase.

entities.name: Anorexia and Dysgeusia
entities.description: Profound loss of appetite accompanied by altered or metallic taste perception.

entities.name: Nausea and Vomiting
entities.description: Gastrointestinal symptoms of nausea and emesis during early dengue phase.

entities.name: Asthenia and Malaise
entities.description: Profound generalized physical weakness, fatigue, and constitutional prostration.

entities.name: Tender Cervical Lymphadenopathy
entities.description: Mild tender reactive lymphadenopathy commonly palpable in cervical nodal stations.

entities.name: Critical Capillary Leakage
entities.description: Transient systemic endothelial hyperpermeability causing plasma leakage into serosal cavities.

entities.name: Severe Abdominal Pain
entities.description: Severe persistent abdominal tenderness signaling acute plasma extravasation.

entities.name: Persistent Incessant Vomiting
entities.description: Incessant vomiting preventing oral intake and indicating decompensation risk.

entities.name: Subclinical Plasma Leakage
entities.description: Early covert transudation of fluid into serous cavities prior to overt clinical shock.

entities.name: Clinically Evident Ascites
entities.description: Accumulation of transudative plasma fluid within the peritoneal cavity.

entities.name: Right Pleural Effusion
entities.description: Transudative fluid collection in pleural space with marked right-sided predominance.

entities.name: Mucosal Epistaxis
entities.description: Spontaneous nasal bleeding provoked by thrombocytopenia and endothelial dysfunction.

entities.name: Severe Gingival Hemorrhage
entities.description: Spontaneous oral mucosal hemorrhage along gingival margins.

entities.name: Menorrhagia and Metrorrhagia
entities.description: Abnormally prolonged or heavy uterine bleeding during acute dengue thrombocytopenia.

entities.name: Gastrointestinal Melena
entities.description: Black tarry stool evacuation resulting from upper gastrointestinal bleeding.

entities.name: Frank Hematemesis
entities.description: Vomiting of blood or coffee-ground material reflecting acute gastrointestinal hemorrhage.

entities.name: Macroscopic Hematuria
entities.description: Grossly visible blood in urine caused by urinary tract microvascular hemorrhage.

entities.name: Tender Hepatomegaly
entities.description: Smooth painful enlargement of the liver extending > 2 cm beneath the costal margin.

entities.name: Lethargy and Agitation
entities.description: Significant changes in mental alertness presenting as deep lethargy or agitation.

entities.name: Dengue Shock Syndrome
entities.description: Life-threatening hypovolemic circulatory collapse resulting from severe capillary leak.

entities.name: Profound Hypovolemic Shock
entities.description: Extreme depletion of effective circulating volume causing end-organ ischemia.

entities.name: Massive Systemic Hemorrhage
entities.description: Catastrophic bleeding across multiple anatomic compartments in severe dengue.

entities.name: Acute Severe Hepatitis
entities.description: Direct viral cytopathic liver injury with transaminases elevated > 1000 U/L.

entities.name: Acute Liver Failure
entities.description: Rapid loss of liver synthetic and clearance function with encephalopathy.

entities.name: Dengue Myocarditis
entities.description: Inflammatory myocardial damage causing contractile dysfunction and conduction blocks.

entities.name: Acute Encephalopathy
entities.description: Global cerebral dysfunction induced by metabolic insults and cerebral edema.

entities.name: Dengue Acute Encephalitis
entities.description: Direct flavivirus central nervous system invasion causing parenchymal brain inflammation.

entities.name: Acute Kidney Injury
entities.description: Abrupt decline in renal excretory function due to hypovolemia and rhabdomyolysis.

entities.name: Acute Respiratory Distress
entities.description: Severe respiratory insufficiency due to inflammatory alveolar capillary hyperpermeability.

entities.name: Convalescent Fluid Overload
entities.description: Iatrogenic circulatory fluid overload during the spontaneous extravasate reabsorption phase.

entities.name: Convalescent Hypervolemic Diuresis
entities.description: Spontaneous brisk urine output heralding the recovery phase of dengue.

entities.name: Severe Post-Viral Asthenia
entities.description: Protracted physical and mental exhaustion persisting weeks after viral clearance.

entities.name: Convalescent Bradycardia
entities.description: Physiological benign sinus slowing occurring characteristically during late recovery.

entities.name: Retro-Orbital Headache
entities.description: Intense pain localized behind eyeballs exacerbated by voluntary eye movements.

entities.name: Positive Tourniquet Test
entities.description: Development of petechiae under maintained blood pressure cuff inflation indicating fragility.

entities.name: Herman Convalescent Rash
entities.description: Confluent erythematous eruption punctuated by sharply demarcated round pale islands.

entities.name: Intense Palmar Pruritus
entities.description: Severe localized itch affecting the palmar aspects during the recovery stage.

entities.name: Intense Plantar Pruritus
entities.description: Severe distressing itching over the soles of the feet accompanying late convalescent exanthem resolution.

entities.name: Transient Macular Erythema
entities.description: Early blanching macular flush across upper body in the first 48 hours.

entities.name: Confluent Petechial Exanthem
entities.description: Clustered non-blanching microvascular petechial spots coalescing on distal limbs.

entities.name: Narrow Pulse Pressure
entities.description: Arterial pulse pressure narrowing to <= 20 mmHg signaling compensated shock.

entities.name: Cold Clammy Extremities
entities.description: Cool, diaphoretic, and pale peripheral extremities resulting from intense vasoconstriction.

entities.name: Delayed Capillary Refill
entities.description: Capillary reperfusion prolonged beyond 2 seconds reflecting peripheral hypoperfusion.

entities.name: Rapid Thready Pulse
entities.description: Tachycardic, low-volume peripheral pulse indicating critically reduced stroke volume.

entities.name: Impalpable Peripheral Pulses
entities.description: Inability to palpate distal peripheral pulses during decompensated circulatory collapse.

entities.name: Profound Postural Hypotension
entities.description: Orthostatic arterial pressure drop identifying covert early volume contraction.

entities.name: Right Upper Quadrant Tenderness
entities.description: Localized physical pain elicited by palpation of the right upper abdominal quadrant.

entities.name: Palpable Tender Hepatomegaly
entities.description: Palpable liver edge extending beyond 2 cm below right costal margin with tenderness.

entities.name: Abdominal Shifting Dullness
entities.description: Physical percussion maneuver demonstrating free intraperitoneal fluid transudation.

entities.name: Decreased Breath Sounds
entities.description: Auscultatory reduction of vesicular lung sounds over dependent pleural effusion.

entities.name: Dullness to Percussion
entities.description: Stony dull percussion note elicited over hemithorax with pleural fluid accumulation.

entities.name: Relative Bradycardia
entities.description: Inappropriate heart rate depression relative to core body temperature.

entities.name: Spontaneous Cutaneous Petechiae
entities.description: Spontaneous tiny pinpoint dermal hemorrhages indicating capillary rupture.

entities.name: Confluent Purpuric Ecchymoses
entities.description: Confluent cutaneous bruising and large purpuric lesions on skin.

entities.name: Spontaneous Gingival Oozing
entities.description: Observable continuous blood weeping along gingival margins.

entities.name: Profuse Anterior Epistaxis
entities.description: Active anterior nasal mucosal bleeding visualized during clinical inspection.

entities.name: Subconjunctival Hemorrhage
entities.description: Bright red focal hemorrhage beneath bulbar conjunctiva without ocular injury.

entities.name: Fluctuating Mental Status
entities.description: Alternating lethargy and confusion detectable on neurological physical examination.

entities.name: Marked Restlessness Agitation
entities.description: Observable motor agitation and restless irritability reflecting cerebral hypoperfusion.

entities.name: Severe Axial Spinal Tenderness
entities.description: Exquisite physical tenderness over lumbar spinal and paraspinal structures.

entities.name: Severe Progressive Leukopenia
entities.description: Precipitous reduction in total white blood cell count < 4000/uL on admission.

entities.name: Marked Neutropenia
entities.description: Severe depression of circulating mature neutrophils during acute viremia.

entities.name: Atypical Plasmacytoid Lymphocytosis
entities.description: Circulating activated plasmacytoid lymphocytes appearing near the critical phase.

entities.name: Progressive Thrombocytopenia
entities.description: Rapid decline in peripheral blood platelet count falling below 100,000/uL.

entities.name: Critical Thrombocytopenia Nadir
entities.description: Severe nadir in platelet count dropping below 20,000/uL in high-risk patients.

entities.name: Hemoconcentration Elevation
entities.description: Elevation in hematocrit >= 20% signifying critical intravascular fluid leakage.

entities.name: Elevated Baseline Hematocrit
entities.description: Absolute hematocrit exceeding normal sex thresholds upon initial hospital triage.

entities.name: Prolonged Activated PTT
entities.description: Prolongation of activated partial thromboplastin time reflecting coagulopathy.

entities.name: Mild Prothrombin Prolongation
entities.description: Elevation in prothrombin time and INR reflecting hepatic synthetic compromise.

entities.name: Reduced Plasma Fibrinogen
entities.description: Depletion of circulating plasma fibrinogen reflecting consumptive processes.

entities.name: Elevated D-Dimer Levels
entities.description: Increased serum D-dimer concentration reflecting ongoing microvascular fibrinolysis.

entities.name: Elevated Aspartate Aminotransferase
entities.description: Marked increase in circulating aspartate aminotransferase levels.

entities.name: Elevated Alanine Aminotransferase
entities.description: Elevation in alanine aminotransferase indicating hepatocellular inflammatory stress.

entities.name: Elevated AST ALT Ratio
entities.description: Inversion of transaminases where AST exceeds ALT due to concomitant muscle injury.

entities.name: Marked Hypoalbuminemia
entities.description: Decline in serum albumin concentration tracking the severity of capillary leak.

entities.name: Normal Serum Bilirubin
entities.description: Serum bilirubin remains normal in uncomplicated dengue despite elevated transaminases.

entities.name: Normal Procalcitonin Level
entities.description: Serum procalcitonin remains suppressed (< 0.5 ng/mL) distinguishing viral etiology.

entities.name: Mildly Elevated CRP
entities.description: Modest elevation of C-reactive protein consistent with acute viral illness.

entities.name: Normal Erythrocyte Sedimentation
entities.description: Erythrocyte sedimentation rate remains near normal in acute uncomplicated disease.

entities.name: Elevated Serum Ferritin
entities.description: Profound elevation in serum ferritin reflecting intense immune activation.

entities.name: Serum Lactate Elevation
entities.description: Elevated circulating lactate concentration indicating tissue hypoperfusion.

entities.name: Elevated Creatine Kinase
entities.description: Elevation in serum creatine kinase reflecting skeletal muscle inflammation.

entities.name: Transient Prerenal Azotemia
entities.description: Elevation of BUN and creatinine due to reduced effective intravascular volume.

entities.name: Hyponatremia Electrolyte Disturbance
entities.description: Depression of serum sodium concentration predisposing to neurological irritability.

entities.name: Hypocalcemia Electrolyte Derangement
entities.description: Reduction in ionized serum calcium concentration in severe dengue shock.

entities.name: Gallbladder Wall Thickening
entities.description: Sonographic gallbladder wall edema >= 3 mm identifying early plasma leakage.

entities.name: Dual-Rim Gallbladder Sign
entities.description: Double-contoured sonographic gallbladder wall sign created by subserosal fluid.

entities.name: Right-Sided Pleural Effusion
entities.description: Right-sided pleural fluid accumulation detected by ultrasonography or radiography.

entities.name: Bilateral Pleural Effusions
entities.description: Bilateral serosal fluid transudation into both pleural hemithoraces.

entities.name: Pericholecystic Fluid Accumulation
entities.description: Anechoic fluid layer encircling the gallbladder wall on ultrasound.

entities.name: Subcapsular Hepatic Fluid
entities.description: Anechoic fluid collection beneath Glisson's hepatic capsule on sonography.

entities.name: Pelvic Free Fluid
entities.description: Anechoic free peritoneal fluid visualized in the dependent pelvic cul-de-sac.

entities.name: Hepatosplenomegaly on Ultrasound
entities.description: Sonographically verified enlargement of the liver and reactive spleen.

entities.name: Increased Peritoneal Echogenicity
entities.description: Ultrasound evidence of diffuse peritoneal and omental inflammatory edema.

entities.name: Pericardial Fluid Collection
entities.description: Small to moderate anechoic pericardial fluid accumulation detected on echocardiography.

entities.name: Blunted Costophrenic Angle
entities.description: Radiographic blunting of the costophrenic recesses by pleural transudate.

entities.name: Dengue NS1 Antigen Positivity
entities.description: Positive serum non-structural protein 1 antigen during days 1-7 of illness.

entities.name: Positive DENV RT-PCR
entities.description: Definitive molecular detection and serotyping of viral RNA by RT-PCR.

entities.name: Dengue IgM Seroconversion
entities.description: Detection of serum anti-dengue IgM antibodies developing after day 5.

entities.name: Secondary Infection IgG Titers
entities.description: Rapid robust rise in anti-dengue IgG titers indicating secondary infection.

entities.name: Aedes Aegypti Vector
entities.description: Primary diurnal anthropophilic mosquito vector breeding in domestic containers.

entities.name: Aedes Albopictus Vector
entities.description: Secondary vector mosquito flourishing in peri-domestic vegetated habitats.

entities.name: Diurnal Mosquito Bites
entities.description: Exposure to daytime-feeding mosquito bites characteristic of Aedes species.

entities.name: Indoor Resting Vectors
entities.description: Habitation of adult mosquitoes sequestered inside shaded domestic living spaces.

entities.name: Domestic Water Storage Containers
entities.description: Uncovered household water reservoirs providing oviposition breeding sites.

entities.name: Discarded Vehicle Tires
entities.description: Discarded automotive tires collecting rainwater and serving as vector nurseries.

entities.name: Non-Biodegradable Plastic Containers
entities.description: Accumulated urban plastic waste functioning as rainwater-trapping larval habitats.

entities.name: Unplanned Urban Shanty Settlements
entities.description: High-density unplanned settlements lacking piped water and vector control.

entities.name: Tropical Monsoon Rainfall Season
entities.description: Tropical seasonal rainfall peaks multiplying mosquito breeding reservoirs.

entities.name: Tropical Endemic Travel Exposure
entities.description: Travel within the previous 14 days to dengue-hyperendemic tropical regions.

entities.name: Maternal Vertical Transmission
entities.description: Transplacental maternal transmission of dengue virus during late pregnancy.

entities.name: Blood Transfusion Transmission
entities.description: Iatrogenic transmission via transfusion of asymptomatic viremic blood products.

entities.name: Percutaneous Laboratory Inoculation
entities.description: Accidental occupational sharps injury with contaminated viremic blood.

entities.name: Intrinsic Human Incubation Period
entities.description: Human intrinsic incubation period ranging strictly from 4 to 10 days.

entities.name: Extrinsic Mosquito Incubation Period
entities.description: Extrinsic mosquito viral dissemination phase lasting 8 to 12 days.

entities.name: Pre-Symptomatic Human Viremia
entities.description: Infectious viremic state occurring 24-48 hours before fever onset.

entities.name: Symptomatic High Viremia Phase
entities.description: High circulating viral titer during days 1-5 of clinical symptoms.

entities.name: Prolonged Atypical Viremia
entities.description: Protracted presence of infectious virus in blood lasting up to 12 days.

entities.name: Secondary Heterotypic Serotype Infection
entities.description: Patient experiencing secondary infection with an alternate DENV serotype.

entities.name: Antibody-Dependent Enhancement
entities.description: Pre-existing cross-reactive antibodies that enhance monocyte viral entry.

entities.name: Pediatric Host Vulnerability
entities.description: Young pediatric patients with high susceptibility to rapid hypovolemic collapse.

entities.name: Elderly Comorbid Host
entities.description: Aged individuals with chronic comorbidities and impaired physiological reserve.

entities.name: Underlying Hemoglobinopathy Trait
entities.description: Underlying hemoglobin disorder predisposing to hemolytic and vascular crises.

entities.name: Marked Neutrophilic Leukocytosis
entities.description: Elevated WBC > 15,000/uL with neutrophilia pointing to bacterial infection.

entities.name: Normal Platelet Count Nadir
entities.description: Platelet counts remaining strictly normal throughout days 4 to 7.

entities.name: Prolonged Fever Beyond Day-10
entities.description: Fever persisting past 10 days contradicting self-limited dengue timeline.

entities.name: Cutaneous Inoculation Eschar
entities.description: Necrotic black crusty eschar identifying chigger-borne scrub typhus.

entities.name: Purulent Conjunctival Exudate
entities.description: Frank purulent ocular discharge identifying acute bacterial ocular infection.

entities.name: Prominent Exudative Pharyngitis
entities.description: Confluent white-yellow tonsillar exudates indicating bacterial or EBV pharyngitis.

entities.name: Markedly Elevated Bilirubin Early
entities.description: Early clinical jaundice and high conjugated bilirubin excluding early dengue.

entities.name: Elevated Procalcitonin Level
entities.description: Elevated serum procalcitonin level confirming invasive bacterial infection.

entities.name: Substantial ESR Elevation
entities.description: Very high erythrocyte sedimentation rate contradicting typical dengue kinetics.

entities.name: Absence of Capillary Leak
entities.description: Total absence of vascular leakage markers excluding severe dengue/DHF.

entities.name: Crystalloid Refractory Shock
entities.description: Circulatory collapse completely unresponsive to isotonic volume expansion.

entities.name: Dense Lobar Consolidation
entities.description: Radiographic dense lobar alveolar consolidation indicating bacterial pneumonia.

entities.name: Meningismus with CSF Pleocytosis
entities.description: Neutrophilic cerebrospinal fluid pleocytosis establishing bacterial meningitis.

entities.name: Destructive Erosive Polyarthritis
entities.description: Destructive or erosive articular lesions contradicting non-erosive dengue.

entities.name: Descending Day-One Pruritic Rash
entities.description: Day 1 descending itchy cephalocaudal eruption typical of Zika infection.

entities.name: Cyclical Shaking Rigors
entities.description: Strictly paroxysmal 48- or 72-hour shaking rigors pathognomonic of malaria.

entities.name: Early Palpable Splenomegaly
entities.description: Early substantial spleen enlargement distinguishing non-dengue tropical fevers.

entities.name: Absence of Secondary Defervescence
entities.description: Absence of temperature defervescence between days 3 and 7 of illness.

entities.name: Early Scleral Icterus Presentation
entities.description: Scleral icterus at symptom inception excluding early dengue presentation.

entities.name: Generalized Bullous Epidermal Desquamation
entities.description: Bullous skin detachment and positive Nikolsky sign excluding dengue.

entities.name: Persistent Leukocytosis Day Five
entities.description: Sustained high leukocyte count on days 4-6 contradicting dengue leukopenia.

entities.name: Intraerythrocytic Parasitemia on Smear
entities.description: Direct microscopic visualization of intraerythrocytic malaria parasites.

entities.name: Chikungunya Polyarthritis Severity
entities.description: Distinction from Chikungunya based on severe symmetric joint inflammation.

entities.name: Chikungunya Absent Plasma Leak
entities.description: Distinction from Chikungunya which lacks capillary leakage syndrome.

entities.name: Chikungunya Normal Platelet Count
entities.description: Distinction from Chikungunya where thrombocytopenia is typically mild or absent.

entities.name: Zika Low-Grade Febrile Profile
entities.description: Distinction from Zika based on pyrexia magnitude and fever profile.

entities.name: Zika Non-Purulent Conjunctivitis
entities.description: Distinction from Zika which prominently manifests bilateral conjunctivitis.

entities.name: Zika Day-One Descending Rash
entities.description: Distinction from Zika based on timing and descending trajectory of rash.

entities.name: Zika Absence of Shock
entities.description: Distinction from Zika which lacks life-threatening plasma leakage.

entities.name: Leptospirosis Neutrophilic Leukocytosis
entities.description: Distinction from Leptospirosis where neutrophilia contrasts with leukopenia.

entities.name: Leptospirosis Conjunctival Suffusion
entities.description: Distinction from Leptospirosis based on marked ciliary conjunctival suffusion.

entities.name: Leptospirosis Early Hepatorenal Failure
entities.description: Distinction from Leptospirosis based on early combined jaundice and renal failure.

entities.name: Leptospirosis Marked Calf Tenderness
entities.description: Distinction from Leptospirosis which features exquisite gastrocnemius tenderness.

entities.name: Malaria Cyclical Shaking Chills
entities.description: Distinction from Malaria based on periodic 48- or 72-hour febrile paroxysms.

entities.name: Malaria Intraerythrocytic Parasitemia
entities.description: Distinction from Malaria based on intraerythrocytic parasites on blood smear.

entities.name: Malaria Prominent Hemolytic Anemia
entities.description: Distinction from Malaria based on hemolytic anemia versus hemoconcentration.

entities.name: Malaria Early Splenomegaly Presentation
entities.description: Distinction from Malaria based on prominent early splenic enlargement.

entities.name: Scrub Typhus Inoculation Eschar
entities.description: Distinction from Scrub Typhus based on presence of diagnostic necrotic eschar.

entities.name: Scrub Typhus Prominent Lymphadenopathy
entities.description: Distinction from Scrub Typhus which exhibits marked generalized adenopathy.

entities.name: Enteric Typhoid Stepladder Fever
entities.description: Distinction from Typhoid fever based on insidious stepladder fever curve.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, abrupt high fever, febrile phase, sudden pyrexia
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Sudden explosive onset of continuous high-grade pyrexia (often 39°C to 40°C) with rigors heralding the acute febrile phase of dengue.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, saddleback fever pattern, biphasic temperature, defervescence remission
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Characteristic biphasic or saddleback thermal trajectory with initial pyrexia for 3-4 days, temporary remission, and a secondary febrile spike around days 5-6.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, frontal headache, severe cephalalgia, early febrile sign
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Intractable throbbing frontal and retro-orbital headache presenting in the earliest hours of viremia.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, breakbone myalgia, muscle pain, backache
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Excruciating musculoskeletal body aches and severe myalgias earning dengue historical moniker breakbone fever.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, severe arthralgia, joint pains, polyarthralgia
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Intense polyarthralgias affecting large and small peripheral joints without frank inflammatory joint effusion.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, lumbar backpain, spinal ache, axial bone pain
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Incapacitating low back and spinal aches contributing to characteristic prostration during the febrile phase.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, facial flushing, cutaneous erythema, early vascular dilation
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Conspicuous cutaneous vascular engorgement producing diffuse facial, neck, and chest flushing in the first 24 to 48 hours.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, diffuse blanching erythema, macular rash, early febrile exanthem
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Early transient macular or maculopapular blanching eruption appearing during initial pyrexia.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, anorexia, dysgeusia, altered taste, metallic taste
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Complete loss of appetite accompanied by unpleasant metallic or altered taste sensation (dysgeusia).

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, nausea, vomiting, gastrointestinal distress, emesis
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Recurrent nausea and early emesis due to systemic viremia and acute gastrointestinal irritation.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, asthenia, malaise, profound fatigue, prostration
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Severe constitutional prostration, overwhelming physical weakness, and bed-bound lethargy.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, cervical lymphadenopathy, reactive lymphadenitis, nodal enlargement
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Mild-to-moderate tender enlargement of posterior cervical and submandibular lymph chains.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, critical plasma leakage, vascular hyperpermeability, defervescence leakage
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Sudden systemic endothelial barrier dysfunction leading to massive extravasation of intravascular fluid during defervescence (days 3-7).

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, severe abdominal pain, WHO warning sign, subserosal edema pain
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Intense persistent epigastric or right upper quadrant abdominal pain representing a cardinal WHO warning sign of impending plasma leakage.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, persistent vomiting, warning sign, frequent emesis
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Inability to tolerate oral fluids due to persistent vomiting (>= 3 episodes within 24 hours), heralding plasma leakage.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, subclinical plasma leakage, covert extravasation, early serosal fluid
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Extravascular plasma filtration into serosal spaces initially detectable only via sonographic gallbladder wall thickening or pleural fluid.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, ascites, peritoneal fluid accumulation, plasma leakage
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Progressive peritoneal fluid accumulation causing abdominal distension, discomfort, and shifting dullness in severe dengue.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, pleural effusion, right-sided effusion, thoracic fluid leak
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Predominantly right-sided or bilateral transudative pleural effusion developing during the critical phase of vascular leakage.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, epistaxis, mucosal bleeding, nasal hemorrhage
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Spontaneous nasal mucosal hemorrhage resulting from microvascular fragility and acute severe thrombocytopenia.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, gingival bleeding, gum hemorrhage, mucosal diathesis
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Spontaneous bleeding from oral mucosal margins and gingival sulci during teeth brushing or rest.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, menorrhagia, abnormal uterine bleeding, vaginal hemorrhage
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Profuse unseasonal uterine or menstrual hemorrhage during the critical leakage phase.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, gastrointestinal melena, upper GI bleeding, tarry stools
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Passage of black tarry stools indicating significant upper gastrointestinal hemorrhage exacerbated by mucosal microvascular stress.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, hematemesis, coffee ground emesis, acute GI hemorrhage
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Vomiting of fresh red blood or altered coffee-ground material indicating overt gastrointestinal mucosal erosion.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, hematuria, macroscopic urinary bleeding, renal tract hemorrhage
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Frank gross red urine output secondary to microvascular renal tubular or bladder mucosal capillary leakage.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, tender hepatomegaly, liver enlargement, warning sign
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Painful liver enlargement exceeding 2 cm below the right costal margin, a critical WHO prognostic warning sign.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, lethargy, agitation, cerebral hypoperfusion, restlessness
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Altered level of consciousness manifesting as extreme drowsiness, apathy, or paradoxical motor agitation due to cerebral hypoperfusion.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, dengue shock syndrome, DSS, compensated shock, decompensated shock
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Life-threatening hemodynamic collapse characterized by narrowing pulse pressure (<= 20 mmHg) or unrecordable blood pressure from massive capillary permeability.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, profound hypovolemic shock, circulatory failure, vascular collapse
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Critical intravascular volume depletion precipitating end-organ ischemic damage, lactic acidosis, and multiple organ dysfunction.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, massive systemic hemorrhage, catastrophic bleeding, disseminated coagulopathy
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Catastrophic multi-site hemorrhage driven by severe consumptive coagulopathy, marked thrombocytopenia, and prolonged shock.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, acute severe hepatitis, transaminitis, hepatocellular necrosis
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Extensive hepatocellular necrosis manifesting with marked serum transaminase elevations exceeding 1,000 U/L.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, acute liver failure, hepatic encephalopathy, fulminant hepatitis
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Fulminant hepatic dysfunction with prolonged prothrombin time, jaundice, and hepatic encephalopathy in expanded dengue syndrome.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, dengue myocarditis, myocardial depression, arrhythmias
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Direct arboviral myocardial injury causing conduction disturbances, ventricular hypokinesia, and reduced ejection fraction.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, acute encephalopathy, metabolic encephalopathy, coma
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Neurological depression driven by hepatic injury, cerebral edema, severe hyponatremia, and tissue hypoperfusion.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, acute encephalitis, viral neuroinvasion, seizures
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Direct neuroinvasive flaviviral infection of neural parenchyma presenting with seizures, focal neurological deficits, and coma.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, acute kidney injury, renal failure, acute tubular necrosis
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Prerenal hypoperfusion evolving into ischemic acute tubular necrosis and sudden oliguria during prolonged dengue shock.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, acute respiratory distress, ARDS, non-cardiogenic pulmonary edema
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Non-cardiogenic alveolar pulmonary edema and tachypnea triggered by systemic inflammatory cytokine surge and microvascular leak.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, convalescent fluid overload, pulmonary edema, hypervolemia
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Iatrogenic pulmonary edema and respiratory distress precipitated by excessive intravenous crystalloid administration during plasma reabsorption (days 7-10).

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, convalescent diuresis, recovery diuresis, physiological fluid resorption
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Profuse spontaneous urinary diuresis marking the resolution of capillary hyperpermeability and systemic recovery.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, post-viral asthenia, chronic fatigue, convalescent exhaustion
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Prolonged debilitating fatigue, depressive mood, and exercise intolerance lasting several weeks to months following acute recovery.

relationships.keywords: MANIFESTS_AS, convalescent bradycardia, relative sinus bradycardia, recovery sign
relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Transient benign sinus bradycardia (heart rate 40-50 bpm) observed during physiological convalescence.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK, retro-orbital pain, ocular motion headache, cardinal symptom
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Severe retrobulbar ache acutely aggravated by ocular motion or pressure, representing a classical pathognomonic hallmark of dengue fever.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK, tourniquet test, petechial fragility, Rumpel Leede sign
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Bedside demonstration of >= 10 petechiae per square inch under mid-blood pressure cuff inflation for 5 minutes, confirming microvascular capillary fragility.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK, Herman rash, islands of white, sea of red, pathognomonic exanthem
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Confluent maculopapular petechial exanthem with round pale uninvolved skin patches ('islands of white in a sea of red') appearing on days 6 to 8.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK, palmar pruritus, recovery itch, convalescent hallmark
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Severe, agonizing pruritus localized specifically to palmar surfaces coinciding with the appearance of the convalescent Herman rash.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK, plantar pruritus, sole itching, recovery rash symptom
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Severe distressing itching over the soles of the feet accompanying late convalescent exanthem resolution.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, transient macular erythema, facial flush, early exanthem
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Diffuse, transient, blanching erythematous flush over face, neck, and thorax occurring during the initial 24 to 48 hours of pyrexia.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, confluent petechial rash, purpura, dependent exanthem
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Extensive non-blanching petechial shower coalescing over the lower extremities and pressure points during the late critical and convalescent phases.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK, narrow pulse pressure, compensated shock, systolic diastolic gap
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Narrowing difference between systolic and diastolic arterial pressures to <= 20 mmHg, defining compensated dengue shock.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, cold clammy extremities, peripheral vasoconstriction, hypoperfusion sign
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Marked peripheral vasoconstriction producing cool, moist, and pale distal extremities during progressive plasma leakage.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, delayed capillary refill, perfusion assessment, triage sign
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Prolongation of nail bed capillary reperfusion time exceeding 2 seconds, reflecting severe systemic hypoperfusion.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, rapid thready pulse, tachycardia, weak peripheral pulse
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Weak, high-frequency, low-amplitude radial arterial pulse indicative of diminished stroke volume.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, impalpable peripheral pulses, unrecordable blood pressure, decompensated shock
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Total absence of palpable radial or dorsalis pedis pulsations marking decompensated hypovolemic dengue shock.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, postural hypotension, orthostatic drop, early hypovolemia
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Orthostatic drop in systolic blood pressure > 20 mmHg upon standing, detecting early intravascular volume depletion.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, right upper quadrant tenderness, RUQ pain, hepatic palpation
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Exquisite tenderness upon palpation of the right hypochondrium over the congested liver and edematous gallbladder bed.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, palpable tender hepatomegaly, liver enlargement, warning sign
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Physical palpation of a tender, smooth liver edge descending > 2 cm beneath the right costal margin.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, abdominal shifting dullness, ascites percussion, fluid wave
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Bedside physical percussion demonstrating positional shift of abdominal flank dullness confirming moderate peritoneal ascites.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, decreased breath sounds, lung bases, pleural effusion sign
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Auscultatory attenuation or absence of vesicular breath sounds over the right lung base from accumulating pleural fluid.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, dullness to percussion, chest exam, pleural fluid
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Stony percussion dullness over the right hemithorax indicating significant plasma extravasation into the pleural cavity.

relationships.keywords: HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK, relative bradycardia, Faget sign, pulse temperature dissociation
relationships.description: [HAS_PATHOGNOMONIC_HALLMARK] Inappropriate slowing of heart rate relative to high body temperature (Faget sign) seen during late febrile and recovery stages.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, spontaneous petechiae, pinpoint hemorrhages, microvascular fragility
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Pinpoint non-blanching dermal hemorrhages appearing spontaneously over limbs and trunk without external trauma.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, purpuric ecchymoses, skin bruising, hemorrhagic diathesis
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Large confluent subcutaneous ecchymoses and extensive purpuric patches at venipuncture and pressure sites.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, spontaneous gingival oozing, gum bleeding, mucosal sign
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Continuous oozing of blood from the dental gingiva observable on physical inspection of the oral cavity.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, profuse anterior epistaxis, nasal bleeding, clinical sign
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Active bilateral or unilateral hemorrhage from Kiesselbach's plexus requiring anterior nasal packing.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, subconjunctival hemorrhage, scleral bleeding, ocular sign
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Spontaneous bright red extravasation of blood beneath the bulbar conjunctiva in the absence of ocular trauma.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, fluctuating mental status, encephalopathy exam, consciousness
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Waxing and waning orientation and responsiveness on bedside Glasgow Coma Scale evaluation in severe dengue.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, restlessness agitation, impending shock, delirium
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Psychomotor irritability and acute distress signaling cerebral hypoxia from decompensating microcirculation.

relationships.keywords: PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN, axial spinal tenderness, paraspinal myalgia, spine exam
relationships.description: [PHYSICAL_EXAM_SIGN] Pain elicited by gentle percussion or palpation along the lumbar spine and paraspinal musculature during acute illness.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, severe progressive leukopenia, low WBC, early triage lab
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Early precipitous drop in total leukocyte count (< 4,000/uL, frequently < 2,500/uL) heralding the onset of dengue viremia.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, marked neutropenia, absolute neutrophil count, early nadir
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Severe suppression of absolute neutrophil count driven by marrow megakaryocyte and myeloid precursor suppression.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, atypical lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes, blood smear
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Emergence of Downey-type reactive atypical lymphocytes and plasmacytoid mononuclear cells on peripheral blood film at defervescence.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, progressive thrombocytopenia, platelet drop, triage marker
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Rapid day-by-day decline in platelet count dropping below 100,000/uL between days 3 and 6 of illness.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, critical thrombocytopenia nadir, profound platelet loss, severe dengue
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Extreme drop in platelets to < 20,000/uL reflecting immune destruction and transient marrow megakaryocytic hypoplasia.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, hemoconcentration elevation, hematocrit rise, plasma leak marker
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Acute rise in hematocrit >= 20% above age- and sex-adjusted population baseline, providing quantitative objective proof of plasma leakage.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, elevated baseline hematocrit, high hematocrit, triage threshold
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Absolute hematocrit exceeding 45% in adult males or 40% in females at admission triage, indicating advanced plasma leakage.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, prolonged aPTT, intrinsic coagulation, clotting prolongation
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Significant lengthening of activated partial thromboplastin time secondary to impaired hepatic synthesis and endothelial activation.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, prolonged prothrombin time, elevated INR, extrinsic pathway
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Mild elevation in prothrombin time and international normalized ratio (INR), worsening markedly in fulminant hepatic failure.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, reduced fibrinogen, hypofibrinogenemia, consumptive coagulopathy
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Decreased circulating fibrinogen levels due to microvascular consumption and subclinical disseminated intravascular activation.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, elevated d-dimer, fibrin degradation, microthrombosis
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Significant elevation in fibrin degradation products and D-dimer reflecting extensive microvascular endothelial fibrin turnover.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, elevated AST, serum transaminase, liver injury
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Prominent rise in serum aspartate aminotransferase (AST), often 2- to 10-fold normal, reflecting both hepatic and myocyte damage.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, elevated ALT, transaminitis, hepatocellular necrosis
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Moderate rise in serum alanine aminotransferase (ALT) signifying viral-mediated hepatocellular inflammation.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, elevated AST ALT ratio, AST greater than ALT, transaminase inversion
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Characteristic laboratory pattern where AST is significantly higher than ALT (ratio > 1.0), typical of dengue and rare in viral hepatitis.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, hypoalbuminemia, low serum albumin, plasma leakage surrogate
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Progressive decrease in serum albumin parallel to the magnitude of systemic endothelial hyperpermeability and serosal transudation.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, normal serum bilirubin, absence of jaundice, liver chemistry
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Preservation of normal or only borderline elevated total and direct serum bilirubin despite significant transaminase elevation.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, normal procalcitonin, low PCT, bacterial sepsis discriminator
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Serum procalcitonin remaining < 0.5 ng/mL, discriminating uncomplicated dengue from acute pyogenic bacterial septicemia.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, mildly elevated CRP, C-reactive protein, viral pattern
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Moderate or low C-reactive protein elevation (< 30-50 mg/L) contrasting sharply with high values seen in bacterial sepsis.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, normal ESR, low sedimentation rate, inflammatory marker
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Preservation of normal or only mildly elevated erythrocyte sedimentation rate in uncomplicated acute dengue.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, elevated serum ferritin, hyperferritinemia, macrophage activation
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Marked hyperferritinemia (> 1,200 to > 10,000 ng/mL) correlating with severe immune activation and vascular leakage risk.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, serum lactate elevation, lactic acidosis, tissue hypoperfusion
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Elevated arterial and venous blood lactate (> 2.0-4.0 mmol/L) reflecting covert systemic anaerobic tissue hypoperfusion in dengue shock.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, elevated creatine kinase, high CK, viral myositis
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Serum creatine kinase (CK) elevation secondary to extensive viral-mediated skeletal myocyte breakdown.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, prerenal azotemia, elevated BUN creatinine, volume contraction
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Acute elevations in blood urea nitrogen and serum creatinine responsive to prompt intravenous isotonic crystalloid expansion.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, hyponatremia, low serum sodium, electrolyte disturbance
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Common acute serum sodium reduction (< 130 mEq/L) predisposing vulnerable pediatric patients to encephalopathic seizures.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, hypocalcemia, low ionized calcium, cardiac contractility
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Decreased serum total and ionized calcium concentrations correlating with the severity of plasma leakage and cardiac depression.

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING, gallbladder wall thickening, subserosal edema, ultrasound triage
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Point-of-care ultrasound demonstration of thickened gallbladder wall (>= 3.0 mm) without gallstones, an early sensitive index of plasma leakage.

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING, dual-rim gallbladder sign, striated gallbladder, subserosal hypoechoic rim
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Striated subserosal hypoechoic fluid halo producing a double-contoured gallbladder wall on bedside sonography.

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING, right pleural effusion, thoracic ultrasound, fluid accumulation
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Sonographic or radiographic demonstration of fluid in the right pleural cavity, the single most sensitive serosal site of leakage.

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING, bilateral pleural effusions, chest radiography, severe leak
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Radiographic and sonographic blunting of both costophrenic sulci signaling extensive, high-grade microvascular fluid filtration.

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING, pericholecystic fluid, gallbladder ultrasound, serosal leak
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Anechoic fluid cuff surrounding the gallbladder fundus and body on abdominal bedside sonography.

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING, subcapsular hepatic fluid, liver ultrasound, plasma leak
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Thin anechoic subcapsular fluid rim along the anterior and inferior hepatic margins on targeted POCUS exam.

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING, pelvic free fluid, pouch of Douglas, ultrasound ascites
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Bedside identification of dependent free peritoneal fluid in the pouch of Douglas or rectovesical pouch.

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING, hepatosplenomegaly ultrasound, visceral enlargement, sonography
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Objective sonographic measurement demonstrating craniocaudal hepatic enlargement and reactive splenic engorgement.

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING, peritoneal echogenicity, mesenteric thickening, edematous omentum
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Diffuse hyperechogenicity of the peritoneal lining and thickened edematous omentum accompanying transudative ascites.

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING, pericardial fluid collection, pericardial effusion, echocardiography
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Echocardiographic detection of anechoic fluid separation of pericardial layers in severe capillary leakage.

relationships.keywords: IMAGING_FINDING, blunted costophrenic angle, chest xray, upright radiograph
relationships.description: [IMAGING_FINDING] Upright posterior-anterior chest radiograph showing obliteration of the right or bilateral costophrenic recesses by transudative fluid.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, dengue NS1 antigen, NS1 ELISA, early diagnostic marker
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Detection of circulating non-structural protein 1 (NS1) by rapid test or ELISA during days 1 to 7 of acute febrile illness.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, positive DENV RT-PCR, molecular detection, viral RNA
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Amplification of dengue viral RNA by reverse-transcriptase polymerase chain reaction, providing definitive serotype identification during early viremia.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, dengue IgM seroconversion, MAC-ELISA, primary antibody response
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Emergence of dengue-specific IgM antibodies by capture ELISA from day 5 onward, confirming acute or recent infection.

relationships.keywords: EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN, high IgG titers, secondary infection serology, early IgG rise
relationships.description: [EXHIBITS_LAB_PATTERN] Hyper-elevated dengue-specific IgG titers appearing within the first 3 to 5 days, pathognomonic of secondary heterotypic infection.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO, Aedes aegypti, primary vector, urban mosquito, domestic breeder
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Inoculation by infected female Aedes aegypti mosquitoes, the primary anthropophilic urban vector thriving in domestic environments.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO, Aedes albopictus, Asian tiger mosquito, peri-domestic vector
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Transmission by Aedes albopictus mosquitoes, competent peri-domestic vectors exhibiting broader cold tolerance into temperate zones.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO, diurnal mosquito bites, daytime biting, peak dawn dusk biting
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Daylight mosquito feeding activity with bimodal peaks during the early morning hours and late afternoon before dusk.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO, indoor resting vectors, endophilic mosquitoes, domestic seclusion
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Endophilic behavior of Aedes aegypti resting quietly in dark indoor areas under furniture, beds, and hanging clothing.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO, water storage containers, cisterns, clay jars, domestic breeding
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Exposure to artificial water reservoirs (cisterns, drums, clay jars, buckets) maintained in homes due to deficient piped water infrastructure.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO, discarded vehicle tires, tire breeding sites, artificial habitats
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Environmental exposure to discarded automotive tires collecting stagnant rainwater, providing optimal mosquito larval microhabitats.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO, plastic containers, solid waste, larval habitat
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Dense accumulation of discarded plastic waste, cups, and food packaging that hold stagnant rainwater in urban settlements.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO, unplanned urban settlements, slum crowding, inadequate infrastructure
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Residence in crowded tropical shantytowns characterized by high human density, lack of sanitation, and open drainage.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO, monsoon rainfall season, rainy season, seasonal peak transmission
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Seasonal travel or residence during and immediately following high-rainfall tropical monsoon seasons when vector density peaks.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO, tropical endemic travel, travel history, hyperendemic countries
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Recent residence or travel within the preceding 14 days to hyperendemic tropical regions across Asia, Latin America, or Africa.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO, maternal vertical transmission, perinatal dengue, transplacental infection
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Peripartum transplacental transmission from an acutely viremic mother to the fetus, risking preterm birth and neonatal dengue shock.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO, blood transfusion transmission, iatrogenic viremia, blood products
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Rare iatrogenic transmission through transfusion of contaminated whole blood, platelets, or fresh frozen plasma from viremic donors.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO, percutaneous laboratory inoculation, needlestick transmission, biohazard
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Accidental needle-stick or mucocutaneous exposure to high-titer dengue viral cultures or clinical specimens in health care workers.

relationships.keywords: INCUBATION_PERIOD, intrinsic incubation period, 4 to 10 days, symptom onset delay
relationships.description: [INCUBATION_PERIOD] Silent biological viral replication in human dendritic cells and reticuloendothelial tissues lasting 4 to 10 days (typically 5 to 7 days) prior to fever.

relationships.keywords: INCUBATION_PERIOD, extrinsic incubation period, mosquito viral dissemination, 8 to 12 days
relationships.description: [INCUBATION_PERIOD] Temperature-dependent viral replication in the mosquito midgut and dissemination to salivary glands lasting 8 to 12 days at 25-28°C.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO, pre-symptomatic viremia, early infectious window, silent transmission
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] High human viremia capable of transmitting infection to biting Aedes vectors 1 to 2 days prior to the clinical onset of fever.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO, symptomatic high viremia, early febrile transmission, vector infectiousness
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] High-grade circulating viral loads during the first 4 to 5 days of illness maximizing vector infectivity.

relationships.keywords: EXPOSURE_TO, prolonged atypical viremia, protracted viral shedding, extended transmission
relationships.description: [EXPOSURE_TO] Extended circulating viremia documented to persist up to 12 days in exceptional severe cases or immunocompromised hosts.

relationships.keywords: HIGH_RISK_HOST, secondary heterotypic infection, heterologous serotype, severe dengue risk
relationships.description: [HIGH_RISK_HOST] Host infected with a second heterologous DENV serotype distinct from primary infection, dramatically multiplying severe dengue risk.

relationships.keywords: HIGH_RISK_HOST, antibody-dependent enhancement, ADE, sub-neutralizing antibodies
relationships.description: [HIGH_RISK_HOST] Pathophysiological mechanism where pre-existing non-neutralizing antibodies facilitate viral entry into Fc-receptor-bearing monocytes.

relationships.keywords: HIGH_RISK_HOST, pediatric host vulnerability, infants, children severe shock
relationships.description: [HIGH_RISK_HOST] Infants with waning maternal antibodies and young children with narrower baseline pulse pressures, carrying disproportionate DSS mortality.

relationships.keywords: HIGH_RISK_HOST, elderly comorbid host, geriatric dengue, chronic comorbidities
relationships.description: [HIGH_RISK_HOST] Older adults with underlying cardiovascular disease, diabetes, or renal insufficiency, prone to atypical presentations and fluid overload.

relationships.keywords: HIGH_RISK_HOST, hemoglobinopathy trait, sickle cell disease, thalassemia, severe hemolysis
relationships.description: [HIGH_RISK_HOST] Patients with sickle cell hemoglobinopathy or thalassemia, predisposing to profound hemolytic crises and severe hepatic injury during dengue.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, neutrophilic leukocytosis, high WBC, bacterial sepsis, bandemia
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Presence of significant leukocytosis (WBC > 15,000/uL) with marked left shift rules out uncomplicated acute dengue, indicating acute bacterial infection.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, normal platelet count, platelets > 150000, rules out severe dengue
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Complete maintenance of normal platelet counts (> 150,000/uL) between days 4 and 7 rules out severe dengue and dengue hemorrhagic fever.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, fever beyond 10 days, prolonged pyrexia, excludes acute dengue
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Pyrexia persisting continuously for more than 10 to 14 days rules out acute uncomplicated dengue, indicating typhoid, tuberculosis, or abscess.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, cutaneous eschar, tache noire, scrub typhus hallmark
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Detection of a black necrotic crusty cutaneous eschar rules out dengue, establishing diagnosis of Orientia tsutsugamushi (scrub typhus).

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, purulent conjunctival exudate, bacterial conjunctivitis, discharge
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Copious purulent or mucopurulent conjunctival discharge rules out uncomplicated dengue arboviral infection, indicating bacterial conjunctivitis.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, exudative pharyngitis, tonsillar exudates, streptococcal pharyngitis
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Confluent tonsillar or pharyngeal follicular exudates rules out dengue, pointing to Group A Streptococcus, Epstein-Barr virus, or adenovirus.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, early high bilirubin, direct hyperbilirubinemia, jaundice day 1-3
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Marked hyperbilirubinemia and clinical jaundice during days 1 to 3 of fever rules out dengue, pointing to leptospirosis, malaria, or biliary sepsis.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, elevated procalcitonin, high PCT, bacterial sepsis marker
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Serum procalcitonin > 1.0 to 2.0 ng/mL on admission rules out uncomplicated dengue, strongly indicating acute invasive bacterial septicemia.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, marked ESR elevation, high erythrocyte sedimentation, chronic inflammation
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Marked erythrocyte sedimentation rate elevation (> 60-80 mm/hr) rules out acute uncomplicated dengue, which maintains normal or low ESR.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, absence of capillary leak, no hemoconcentration, rules out DHF
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Absolute lack of hemoconcentration, pleural effusions, ascites, or hypoalbuminemia during defervescence rules out dengue hemorrhagic fever and DSS.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, crystalloid refractory shock, non-responsive shock, septic shock
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Complete failure of arterial blood pressure to respond to adequate titrated crystalloid resuscitation rules out uncomplicated dengue shock, indicating septic or cardiogenic shock.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, dense lobar consolidation, alveolar infiltrate, bacterial pneumonia
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Radiographic confirmation of dense alveolar lobar consolidation with air bronchograms rules out dengue, establishing community-acquired pneumonia.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, CSF pleocytosis, purulent meningitis, cloudy CSF
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Marked neck stiffness paired with lumbar puncture revealing purulent neutrophilic CSF pleocytosis rules out dengue, confirming bacterial meningitis.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, destructive polyarthritis, joint erosions, chronic synovitis
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Chronic joint deformities, synovial hypertrophy, or radiographic marginal bone erosions rules out dengue, indicating Chikungunya or rheumatoid arthritis.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, descending day-one rash, early maculopapular exanthem, Zika hallmark
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Prominent itchy maculopapular rash appearing on day 1 on the face and descending rapidly with mild fever rules out dengue, indicating Zika virus.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, cyclical rigors, shaking chills, 48-hour paroxysms, malaria
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Stereotyped cyclical paroxysms of violent teeth-chattering rigors occurring every 48 or 72 hours rules out dengue, establishing malaria.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, early palpable splenomegaly, massive splenomegaly, malaria typhoid
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Prominent splenomegaly palpable in the first 48 hours of illness rules out dengue, pointing decisively to malaria, visceral leishmaniasis, or typhoid.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, absence of secondary defervescence, persistent unremitting pyrexia
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Unremitting rigid plateau fever failing to defervesce by day 7 without critical phase plasma leakage rules out typical dengue.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, early scleral icterus, jaundice day 1-2, leptospirosis Weil
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Deep yellow scleral icterus present at initial onset of symptoms rules out dengue, pointing toward severe leptospirosis (Weil disease) or yellow fever.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, bullous epidermal desquamation, skin sloughing, SJS TEN
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Flaccid bullae, epidermal detachment, or positive Nikolsky sign rules out dengue exanthem, establishing Stevens-Johnson syndrome or toxic epidermal necrolysis.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, persistent leukocytosis, WBC > 12000 day 5, bacterial etiology
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Leukocyte count remaining > 12,000/uL through days 4 to 6 of fever contradicts dengue's universal leukopenia, ruling out uncomplicated infection.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, intraerythrocytic parasitemia, positive blood smear, Plasmodium
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Direct visualization of Plasmodium trophozoites or schizonts in peripheral blood smear rules out pure dengue fever as the cause of febrile illness.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, Chikungunya, crippling polyarthritis, joint swelling, tenosynovitis
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Differentiated from Chikungunya virus: Chikungunya causes crippling, symmetric, excruciating polyarthritis and tenosynovitis lasting months, whereas dengue presents with diffuse myalgias and backache without chronic destructive arthritis.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, Chikungunya, absence of plasma leakage, no shock, hemoconcentration
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Differentiated from Chikungunya virus: Chikungunya virtually never causes systemic endothelial capillary leakage, hemoconcentration, ascites, or pleural effusions, which are central hallmarks of severe dengue.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, Chikungunya, normal platelets, absence of thrombocytopenia
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Differentiated from Chikungunya virus: Chikungunya rarely produces severe thrombocytopenia (< 100,000/uL), whereas progressive profound platelet decline is characteristic of dengue.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, Zika virus, low-grade fever, temperature contrast
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Differentiated from Zika virus: Zika typically features low-grade pyrexia (< 38.5°C) or absence of fever, whereas dengue presents with explosive high-grade continuous or saddleback fever (39-40°C).

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, Zika virus, non-purulent conjunctivitis, conjunctival injection
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Differentiated from Zika virus: Zika characteristically features prominent bilateral non-purulent conjunctival hyperemia, which is uncommon and subtle in dengue compared to severe retro-orbital pain.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, Zika virus, early descending rash, maculopapular rash
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Differentiated from Zika virus: Zika presents with an early pruritic descending maculopapular rash on days 1 to 2, whereas dengue's characteristic Herman rash appears late during defervescence (days 6-8).

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, Zika virus, absence of plasma leakage, no vascular collapse
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Differentiated from Zika virus: Zika infection pursues a mild, self-limiting course without vascular hyperpermeability, hemoconcentration, or dengue shock syndrome.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, Leptospirosis, neutrophilic leukocytosis, high WBC left shift
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Differentiated from Leptospirosis: Leptospirosis demonstrates marked neutrophilic leukocytosis (WBC > 12,000-15,000/uL) and high CRP/ESR, whereas dengue characteristically exhibits profound leukopenia (< 4,000/uL).

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, Leptospirosis, conjunctival suffusion, ciliary injection
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Differentiated from Leptospirosis: Leptospirosis presents with pathognomonic bilateral ciliary conjunctival suffusion without purulence, contrasting with dengue's dominant retro-orbital pain.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, Leptospirosis, Weil disease, jaundice renal failure, azotemia
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Differentiated from Leptospirosis: Severe leptospirosis (Weil disease) causes early combined direct hyperbilirubinemia and acute oliguric renal failure, whereas dengue features AST > ALT, normal bilirubin, and preserved early renal function.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, Leptospirosis, gastrocnemius tenderness, calf pain
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Differentiated from Leptospirosis: Leptospirosis produces exquisite, incapacitating gastrocnemius calf tenderness, while dengue produces generalized lumbar backache and diffuse muscle pain.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, Malaria, Plasmodium falciparum, cyclical paroxysms, shaking rigors
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Differentiated from Malaria: Malaria presents with stereotypical cyclical paroxysms of severe shaking rigors, fever spikes, and diaphoresis, contrasting with dengue's continuous high fever and saddleback pattern.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, Malaria, intraerythrocytic parasites, Giemsa smear, rapid diagnostic test
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Differentiated from Malaria: Malaria is confirmed by microscopic Giemsa-stained intraerythrocytic trophozoites and positive malaria RDT, whereas dengue is confirmed by viral NS1 antigen and RT-PCR.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, Malaria, hemolytic anemia, unconjugated hyperbilirubinemia, hemoconcentration
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Differentiated from Malaria: Severe malaria induces progressive intravascular hemolysis with falling hematocrit, elevated LDH, and indirect bilirubin, whereas severe dengue produces hemoconcentration with rising hematocrit.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, Malaria, palpable splenomegaly, splenic enlargement
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Differentiated from Malaria: Acute malaria frequently produces rapid, tender splenomegaly on initial examination, whereas dengue predominantly causes hepatomegaly with splenomegaly being rare.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, Scrub Typhus, Orientia tsutsugamushi, black eschar, mite bite
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Differentiated from Scrub Typhus: Scrub typhus features a pathognomonic black crusty inoculation eschar (tache noire) at the chigger bite site, a physical hallmark completely absent in dengue.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, Scrub Typhus, generalized lymphadenopathy, bubonic enlargement
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Differentiated from Scrub Typhus: Scrub typhus characteristically presents with striking regional or generalized lymphadenopathy, which is minimal or subtle in dengue.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, Enteric fever, Salmonella Typhi, stepladder pyrexia, relative bradycardia
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Differentiated from Enteric Typhoid: Typhoid fever presents with an insidious, gradual stepladder fever rise over weeks, rose spots, and bacteremia, contrasting with dengue's hyperacute abrupt onset fever.
